reviewer: separate collaborating agent in the same environment

auditor_development_notes: An in-memory pre-replay self-check using duplicated development JSON caught a stale hardcoded t9 quantile differing from the recorded SciPy quantile at about 1e-10; the audit now uses stdtrit, while recomputing count contrasts, standard errors and sign-flip distributions separately. No candidate source, formal data or inferential rule changed.

numerical_receipt.interpretation: Audit consistency does not turn a strict numerical failure into a receiver pass.
